computed_scope: two exact fixed-mode real scalar gradient-triple coefficients derived from a pinned scalar Gaunt product, scalar eigenvalues, and integration by parts only

declared_conventions.gaunt: G_abc=int_S3 R_a R_b R_c dV is read from the coefficient of R_a in the upstream product R_b R_c.
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3, compact without boundary, Vol(S3)=2*pi^2
declared_conventions.gradient_triple: D_abc=int_S3 R_a nabla^i R_b nabla_i R_c dV. On the closed unit S3, D_abc=(lambda_b+lambda_c-lambda_a)G_abc/2, derived from Delta(R_b R_c) and integration by parts under Delta R=-lambda R.
declared_conventions.integration_by_parts: D_bac + D_cab = lambda_a G_abc. This is an exact scalar identity in the fixed packet, not a constraint bracket.
declared_conventions.real_scalar_basis: The upstream finite real basis labels and normalization are authoritative. Each R_a is real and orthonormal, and -Delta R_a=lambda_a R_a with lambda_a=n_a(n_a+2).

exact_checks.statement: The fixed scalar Gaunt coefficient equals the preregistered entry read from the pinned upstream real product.
The a-mode eigenvalue uses the declared unit-S3 scalar convention lambda_n=n(n+2).
The scalar gradient-triple coefficient equals (lambda_b+lambda_c-lambda_a)G_abc/2 exactly.
The cyclic scalar coefficients satisfy D_bac+D_cab=lambda_a G_abc exactly, the selected integration-by-parts identity.

primary_sources.not_used_for: the repository-specific real-basis packet, a complete derivative basis, vector/TT couplings, ADM constraints, HDA, Jacobi, BFV, quantum claims, or an absolute measure
primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere, Gen. Rel. Grav. 49 (2017) 139, arXiv:1709.08020
primary_sources.used_for: the unit-S3 scalar eigenvalue convention -Delta Y^(n)=n(n+2)Y^(n), with scalar harmonics treated as convention-dependent generators/checks

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: This only derives scalar gradient triples from scalar Gaunt coefficients. It neither supplies a complete derivative basis nor a vector/TT coupling, ADM, HDA, Jacobi, BFV, or quantum statement.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The fixed real scalar modes obey -Delta R_a=lambda_a R_a on a compact boundaryless unit S3, and all products/integrals use the declared real normalized convention.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: No conclusion extends to unlisted modes, a complete scalar derivative ledger, or a spectral cutoff calculation.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: Only the two labels already present in the pinned selected n=1 diagonal-cos square are read, with degrees n=0,1,2 declared in the input.
